results.content: Marketing|The Good-Better-Best Approach to Pricing. # The Good-Better-Best Approach to Pricing. Why every company should consider a tiered model by Rafi Mohammed. From the Magazine (September–October 2018). ## Summary. Leer en españolLer em português. For decades the auto insurance industry operated on a simple assumption: Consumers are highly price-sensitive, and most will buy the least-expensive plan they can find. But in the early 2000s Allstate conducted some research that caused it to revisit that assumption. Price does matter, it learned, but there’s more to the story: Many drivers worry about being hit with premium hikes if they’re in an accident. And drivers with clean records want to be rewarded.
